description: Staleness sweep of plan-phase prompts: align planner frontmatter model, rewrite planner/auditor Step 7/8 descriptions to the deterministic plan runner, replace dead Spec Sourcing guidance, and fix cam-plan selection description.

userStories.title: Fix subagent-planner.md: model align, Step 7 description, dead Spec Sourcing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the subagent-planner prompt to describe how it is actually spawned and consumed so the planner agent is not misled by stale guidance that no builder honors.
acceptanceCriteria: The `model:` line in .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md equals the `[models] planner` value in scripts/cam/project.toml (both currently claude-opus-4-8); if already equal, no change to that line. The templates/agents/subagent-planner.md `model:` line is left at its seed default (unchanged), and the `model:` line is NOT removed from either copy. [oracle: file-assert test "$(grep -m1 '^model:' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md | sed 's/^model:[[:space:]]*//')" = "$(grep -m1 '^planner' scripts/cam/project.toml | sed 's/.*=[[:space:]]*//;s/"//g')"]

The `description:` field of subagent-planner.md no longer contains 'Invoked from /cam-plan Step 7'; it states the agent is spawned by the deterministic plan runner (runPlanPhase, ADR-0006) - in BOTH copies. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'Invoked from /cam-plan Step 7' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md templates/agents/subagent-planner.md && grep -q 'deterministic plan runner' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]

The Spec Sourcing section no longer references the specSource / Spec / derivedFrom Task-prompt fields (which buildPlannerTaskPrompt / buildReplanPlannerTaskPrompt never pass); it instructs the planner to read the specified issue file (scripts/cam/issues/<id>.json) for the spec - in BOTH copies. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -Eq 'specSource|derivedFrom' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md templates/agents/subagent-planner.md && grep -q 'scripts/cam/issues' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]
Re-embed applied and vendor drift check passes. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Agent frontmatter check passes. [oracle: bun run --bun scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts --check || bun vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Files: .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md (line 3 description, line 4 model, lines 79-84 Spec Sourcing), templates/agents/subagent-planner.md (same, but DO NOT touch its model line), plus regenerated src/templates/embedded.ts via `bun run embed-vendor`. GOTCHA (issue): the frontmatter model field is NOT dead config - src/templates/frontmatter.ts rewrites the `model:` line on `cam config` save, and vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts validates it; align the value only, never remove the line. The stale `claude-fable-5` value named in the issue no longer applies: project.toml [models] planner is now claude-opus-4-8, which already matches the frontmatter, so item (1) is likely a no-op verification - the real edits are the description and Spec Sourcing rewrites. Spec Sourcing rewrite must match buildPlannerTaskPrompt (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:67-73): the planner is named an issue, told not to re-select, told to write the PRD, and reads the issue file itself for the spec. Only .claude/ frontmatter model is cam-cli-specific; description + Spec Sourcing are cam-universal and go in both copies (embed reads templates/, not .claude/). Verify embedded generator embeds templates/ (scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts reads vendor/ + templates/).

userStories.title: Fix cam-plan.md selection description to champion-vs-champion
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need cam-plan.md to describe no-argument issue selection the way selectPlannableIssue actually behaves, so the documented ordering does not contradict the runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: The no-argument selection description no longer says 'rank` asc then numeric id asc'; it accurately describes selectPlannableIssue champion-vs-champion selection (best ranked candidate by min rank vs best unranked candidate by max WSJF, with the unranked champion winning only when its WSJF is strictly higher; ties go to the ranked champion) - in BOTH copies. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'rank` asc then numeric id asc' .claude/commands/cam-plan.md templates/commands/cam-plan.md && grep -q 'WSJF' .claude/commands/cam-plan.md templates/commands/cam-plan.md]
Re-embed applied and vendor drift check passes. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Files: .claude/commands/cam-plan.md (line 11 no-argument bullet), templates/commands/cam-plan.md (line 11), plus regenerated src/templates/embedded.ts via `bun run embed-vendor`. Ground the rewrite in src/issues/select.ts:66-86 (selectPlannableIssue): filter isPlannable, split ranked (rank defined) vs unranked, pickRankedChampion = min rank + numeric-id tie-break, pickUnrankedChampion = max computeWsjf + numeric-id tie-break, unranked wins iff its WSJF strictly greater than ranked champion's WSJF (tie to ranked). This is cam-universal, so both copies + re-embed. Keep the surrounding main-ref / fallback-only text on line 11 intact; only the ordering clause changes.
